Name: Shaphan, Scribe
Summary: Shaphan the scribe read the found book of the law before Josiah, and went with the king's messengers to inquire of Huldah.
KeyStory: Shaphan reads the book before Josiah.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Hilkiah, High Priest; Ahikam, Son of Shaphan; Azaliah, Father of Shaphan
LifeLesson: The scribe who reads God's word aloud becomes its first hearer.
